messages:
tarun: FYI found a parity bug between REST and the JS/TS SDK around function-calling payloads. REST passes nested `tool_params` through to the tool verbatim, SDK flattens nested objects and drops undefined keys, so tools get wrong args. Repro below.
evelyn: ugh. does this happen only with streaming or for normal calls too?
tarun: both, but it was caught in streaming because the tool kept erroring on missing `credentials.client_id`. Minimal curl repro that behaves as expected: 
```bash
curl -X POST \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/chat/completions \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-rc","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"call tool"}],"function_call":{"name":"do_backup","tool_params":{"path":"/mnt/backup","options":{"compress":true,"exclude":["tmp"]},"credentials":{"client_id":"svc-1"}}}'
```
-> tool receives full nested structure.

tarun: JS SDK (v2.6.0) sample from sampleapp: 
```js
await client.chat.create({ model: 'gpt-rc', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'call tool'}], function_call: { name: 'do_backup', tool_params: { path: '/mnt/backup', options: { compress: true, exclude: ['tmp'] }, credentials: { client_id: 'svc-1' } } } });
// Observed network payload (raw): {"function_call":{"name":"do_backup","tool_params":{"path":"/mnt/backup","options.compress":true,"options.exclude":"tmp","credentials":"[object Object]"}}}
// Tool gets credentials as string and options keys flattened -> crashes.
```

jo: looks like our serializer flattens nested maps for querystring compat in one branch and that logic got applied to body serialization for function_call. Also some libs stringify objects when they detect complex types.
evelyn: also noticed retry behavior is compounding the issue: the SDK retry wrapper retries on 502 and resends flattened payloads again, so the tool executed twice with bad args. Users see duplicate side effects.

bot-lint: lint warning: serializer/flattening middleware applied globally. Rule S-47 triggered.

qa-bot: test failure T-9401 created: tests/function_call_parity_spec.js fails on staging; expected nested tool_params, got flattened payload. Linked logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/function-e2e/1203.

tarun: suggested short-term fixes: (1) patch JS SDK to bypass flattening middleware for any body with `function_call` key, (2) add normalization that ensures objects remain objects (no toString coercion), (3) update retry policy to avoid retrying non-idempotent function calls by default.
evelyn: agreed. I'll open RED-3544 and assign to devex+eng-runtime. We'll need a hotfix release for JS (2.6.1) and a generator/serializer test to prevent regressions.
jo: long-term: remove global flattening or scope it only to query/form serializations. Add parity CI job that diffs JS/TS SDK payloads against canonical REST fixtures for function_call endpoints.

qa-bot: added regression test and flagged for backfilling in nightly.
tarun: I'll draft the SDK patch and include an integration test against staging tool invocation. Also update sampleapp snippets to show explicit JSON.stringify use as a temporary workaround.
evelyn: thanks. follow-ups: (1) run payload-compare job across all function-calling endpoints, (2) sweep other SDKs for similar flattening behavior, (3) include changelog note about function_call serialization fix. tagging @devex and @eng-runtime for visibility.
